snippet.title: Pavane: See No Evil (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Pavane: See No Evil
Official Trailer

VIEW GAME PAGE HERE:
qz-productions . itch . io / pavane-see-no-evil

Melody Green saw something she shouldn't have.

A music teacher at a local elementary school finds herself in the midst of something bizarre and unexplainable: an abandoned building, a thick fog enveloping the area, and no wi-fi or phone signal to allow her to call for help.

Faced with strange riddles, eerie messages from her past, and something horrible haunting her from within the screens, Melody realizes that someone or something is calling out to her, trying to show her a truth that could shatter her world and turn her life completely upside down.

FEATURES:

-A psychological horror story of adult fears and difficult choices.
-Artwork by Nikoue.
-3-5 hours (estimated) of puzzle horror gameplay.
-An all-original, atmospheric soundtrack inspired by classical music, Silent Hill, and the sampling techniques of Drakengard.
-Optional events and collectables that slowly unravel Melody's past and personal demons.
-Accessibility features for colorblind, hard of hearing, and photosensitive players.
-Four unique endings.
-No AI generated assets were used in the creation of this game.

Demo coming soon!

WARNING:

Pavane: See No Evil contains disturbing content and mature themes. It is recommended for players aged 16 and up. This game also contains certain unpleasant audio and visual effects, including harsh audio glitching, flashing lights, and jumpscares. You can decrease the intensity of these effects via the accessibility options menu.

More detailed content warnings will be uploaded as a separate file to avoid spoilers.
